# Namaskar AI

> Assamese-first practical AI learning platform focused on learners, professionals, and small businesses in Assam.

## Primary learning resources
- [Namaskar AI Home](https://www.namaskarai.in/): Assamese-first AI learning platform with practical guides and tools.
- [AI in Assamese](https://www.namaskarai.in/ai-in-assamese): Beginner guide for learning AI in Assamese with first-step workflows.
- [ChatGPT in Assamese](https://www.namaskarai.in/chatgpt-in-assamese): Practical setup and day-to-day ChatGPT usage in Assamese.
- [AI Course in Assamese](https://www.namaskarai.in/ai-course-in-assamese): Program overview with curriculum, tracks, and enrollment updates.
- [Learn AI in Assamese in 30 Days](https://www.namaskarai.in/learn-ai-in-assamese-30-days): Structured 30-day roadmap for Assamese learners.
- [Best AI Course for Assamese Speakers](https://www.namaskarai.in/best-ai-course-for-assamese-speakers): Free vs paid vs cohort comparison with clear selection criteria.
- [Learning Assamese with AI](https://www.namaskarai.in/learning-assamese-with-ai): Use AI for Assamese vocabulary, speaking practice, and grammar support.
- [Assamese LLM and Chatbot Guide](https://www.namaskarai.in/assamese-llm-chatbot-guide): Implementation guide for Assamese chatbot and LLM use-cases.
- [About Namaskar AI](https://www.namaskarai.in/about): Mission, principles, and Assam-focused AI education approach.
- [Contact Namaskar AI](https://www.namaskarai.in/contact): Support, collaboration, and media contact channels.
- [Assamese AI FAQ](https://www.namaskarai.in/faq): Direct answers to common AI-learning questions from Assamese audiences.
- [Editorial Policy](https://www.namaskarai.in/editorial-policy): Source standards, fact-check workflow, and correction policy.
- [Press and Collaboration](https://www.namaskarai.in/press-collaboration): Media contact, guest post topics, and collaboration workflow.
